g.text: P+R bord A20 dicht, tijdelijk gratis
py-app-sign-pr-gratis-a20 | type sign | trim 210 x 297 mm, bleed 3 mm | status rebuilt
Bron: tien printbestanden (source/print). Referentie = getrouwe vectorweergave; template = officiele tokenkleuren, 3 mm bleed, variabelen als live tekst. Labels staan in aparte groepen.
Bron: PR_RoadSignage.pdf p1 (RGB (ICC); bleed box in bron nee). Template: trim 210 x 297 mm, bleed 3 mm, totaal 216 x 303 mm.
Variabelen: background-colour = #1A3580; headline = A20 dicht?; body-line-1 = Parkeer nu ; keyword-1 = tijdelijk; keyword-2 = gratis; body-line-2 = op P+R; city = Schiedam; punctuation = .

A4 210 x 297 mm, no bleed in the source (the BleedBox is not set). Navy field with rounded bottom corners (radius 17.93 mm, measured from the path, bottom edge at 241.35 mm); the lower 55.7 mm is white paper (no ink) with the partner mark left and the colour lockup right. In the source the field overshoots the page at the top (to y -65.2 mm,

the shape continues with rounded top corners off the page) and its sides lie exactly on the page edge (x 0 and 210); the template runs the field 3 mm into the bleed at top, left and right and keeps the trim shape of the bottom edge and corners (a small step at the corner centre height lies in the bleed and is cut off). P+R symbol: comp

py-comp-symbol-pr placed at its source position (bars 88.0 mm wide, the label is live text, variable label). Headline A20 dicht? Ubuntu Medium 24.69 mm white (variable headline). Divider: white stroke 4 pt (1.41 mm) from x 7 to 203 mm at y 126.5, the pattern of py-atom-line-divider (the library atom is 0.706 mm, here drawn with Doc.line at 1.41 mm).
